mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (current value 0.07%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% (current value 8.5%) signals economic weakness and recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or rank correlation between UNRATE and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (above 0.1%) and unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates dual stress of monetary tightening and economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1 and UNRATE > 8.0, or rank correlation between interaction signal and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months and CPIAUCSL above 225) signals reduced liquidity and higher risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 225
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or rank correlation between regime condition and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 700, current value 685.0) indicate weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700, or rank correlation between HOUST and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0, current value 94.8263) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or rank correlation between INDPRO and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 700 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it indicates simultaneous demand and supply contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700 and INDPRO < 95.0, or rank correlation between interaction signal and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth above 2% and CPIAUCSL above 225), the S&P 500 is overbought and due for correction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or rank correlation between regime condition and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
